summary.headline: Calamities of the Year
summary.text: Predictions for the year when the Moon, Jupiter, Mars, or Sun occupies the ascendant, including rain, prosperity, earthquakes, war, and relations between kings and people. Chapter 37 explains yearly calamities caused by malefics, especially Mars and Saturn, and by adverse aspects involving the Moon and Sun, including damage to the land, weakened kingship, religious decline, robbery, conflict, and changes of kingdom.
